introHtml: Port Company sweatpants offer a reliable, comfortable foundation for your branded apparel. Made from a cotton-polyester blend with a brushed interior, they provide warmth without bulk—ideal for employee uniforms, team gear, or promotional giveaways. The 9-ounce fleece holds screen printing and embroidery well, making your logo stand out. Choose from several colorways to match your brand palette.
